flags.en: No completion or failure state was recorded.
No artifact delivery was recorded; absence is not proof of non-delivery.
Timestamp-ordered events regress in lifecycle stage.
At least one submitted event declares schema_valid=false.
A dispute was recorded; the report does not adjudicate it.
The trace fails the V1 terminal-state and trusted-source gate.
No task_completed event was recorded; a failure terminal may still exist.
A task_failed event was recorded; report delivery can still succeed.
The trace lacks a request/start or completion/failure timestamp.
At least one event has no non-empty evidence reference; references are not verified here.
The weakest source is bilateral or self-reported; execution score is unchanged.
No trusted settlement evaluation is attached; declared price is not payment proof.

unknown_flag_policy: Preserve and display unknown values; do not discard report.
